notes: Annotation depth: FULL — all services + Other Covered + plan-level + appeals_contact. This is the EMPLOYER-SPONSORED PLAN stress test (County of Sacramento group plan). Distinct regulatory regime from individual marketplace (Ambetter) and SHOP (Blue Shield).
Clean 6-page SBC, no bundling — opposite of Blue Shield's 190/370-page bundled PDFs. Validates parser handles both extremes.

Parser gap (not fixed in this PR): Insurer regex array in sbc-parser.ts has no /western\s+health\s+advantage/ pattern. Parser would emit insurer_name: null. Ground truth annotated as 'Western Health Advantage'. Adding the pattern would close this gap.

Plan year 2026 — most current SBC in the fixture set. Coverage period uses PROPER range format '01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026' (NOT single-date). This is the only fixture that exercises the original /MM/DD/YYYY - MM/DD/YYYY/ parser regex without falling back to the single-date branch from parser fix #2.
Coverage tier: 'Self + Family' — relies on parser fix #3 (extended regex to map 'Self + Family' to 'individual_family').

EMPLOYER-SPONSORED RICHNESS: $0 deductible, $1,500/$3,000 OOP cap, $15 PCP/specialist copays, $0 cost-share for major procedures (inpatient, outpatient surgery facility, advanced imaging, ER copay $35). Approximate Platinum-equivalent actuarial value. No formal AV stated since this is off-marketplace; metal_level is null.

TRUE HMO: referral_required = true. OON is mostly Not Covered (no OON deductible or OOP). ER + emergency transport paid in-network rates regardless of network. Urgent care covered OON only outside service area.

SUD parity: SBC section header 'If you need mental health, behavioral health, or substance abuse services'. SUD parity derivation fires; substance_abuse_outpatient/inpatient mirror mental_health_* with identical cost-sharing.

OOP exclusion CARVE-OUT: SBC says 'Member cost shares for annual hearing exams, chiropractic care and premiums and health care the plan doesn't cover' do NOT count toward OOP limit. Chiropractic is COVERED (Other Covered Services) but its cost-share never counts toward the OOP cap — a subtle plan-design choice limiting chiropractic financial protection.

RICHEST OTHER COVERED LIST of all 7 fixtures: Abortion + Acupuncture + Bariatric + Chiropractic + Infertility + Routine Eye Care Adult — 6 services in 'Other Covered'. None have cost-sharing stated in SBC; all annotated with null cost fields per accuracy rule.
MVS = 'Yes' (subject to ACA employer-mandate Minimum Value Standard).
Children's glasses and children's dental check-up are NOT COVERED on this plan (different from Ambetter and Blue Shield, which cover both at $0). Annotated as covered: false.
WHA appeals contact in SBC text is sparse — refers users to plan documents for the WHA-specific grievance process and to DMHC for state-level help. Customer service phone is 1-888-563-2250 (page 1).
